messages.author: fcf507c4c0753c1b
messages.subject: Bayesian posterior predictive p value
parts: I'm running some Montecarlo Simultations, and I need to use the Bayesian Predictive Checking (Posterior Predictive P-value and the prior posterior predictive P-value), but in the summary option of the "read.Models" command, I cound't find this statistics. Can you help me with that?

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: Bayesian posterior predictive p value
parts:
Hi Andres,

Zhang Lijin submitted a pull request for extracting the PPP information from Monte Carlo outputs, and I extended this to include the prior PPP, too. If you download the development version of the package, you should be able to extract this information from your outputs.

devtools::install_github("michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation")

Hope this helps,
Michael

Take a look at the createModels() function (described in the package vignette). You can easily change the sample size or cluster number using a template file that loops over the conditions of interest.

Best,
